topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: I can't believe this—just when I thought things were settling into a quiet rhythm. The neighbor, of all people, wants to put up a fence. Like the boundary between our yards wasn’t clear enough already. Do they not realize what this does to the view, to the open space that's been natural for so long? I guess some people can't appreciate the unspoken agreement we had, the mutual understanding that kept our space shared and open. Now, they’re carving it up, staking claims like we’re back in the middle ages. I suppose I'll have to go over there, see what can be said to turn this around. But really, why should I have to?
